min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

values.note: Sites reserve site-specific on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov); unreserved sites allow self-registration on arrival. 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, then move to another campground in the park. In winter the water is shut off and every site is first come, first served: no reservations or online payment, pay at the park office or self-pay, single nights only.
